items.title: Cheap Hardware Module Bypasses AMD, Intel Memory Encryption

items.title: OnSolve CodeRED cyberattack disrupts emergency alert systems nationwide
items.description: Risk management company Crisis24 has confirmed its OnSolve CodeRED platform suffered a cyberattack that disrupted emergency notification systems used by state and local governments, police departments, and fire agencies across the United States. [...]
